ac_store.name: AC Store
ac_store.description: Acceptance criteria traceability store persisting ACs as YAML files with bidirectional links to tests and implementations.

agent_registry.name: Agent Registry
agent_registry.description: Central registry of all phase agents with is_ticket_phase flags and produces traits.

agent_telemetry.name: Agent Telemetry
agent_telemetry.description: Event emission and tracking for supervisor dispatch, agent sign-offs, and failure rates.

bootstrap_installer.name: Bootstrap Installer
bootstrap_installer.description: Self-hosting installation system that deploys agents, skills, and hooks into consumer projects.

build_pipeline.name: Build Pipeline
build_pipeline.description: Orchestrates the compilation of templates into platform-specific outputs.

changelog.name: Changelog

commit_guardian.name: Commit Guardian
commit_guardian.description: Pre-commit hook system enforcing code quality, ADR coverage, and structural integrity before every commit.

doc_compliance.name: Doc Compliance

glossary.name: Glossary

injection_builder.description: Assembles context injection payloads delivered to agents at invocation time via the knowledge plane.

knowledge-management.name: Knowledge Management

knowledge_system.name: Knowledge System
knowledge_system.description: Knowledge harvesting and context file maintenance for cross-session learning persistence.

llm_authoring.name: LLM Authoring

precommit_hooks.name: Pre-commit Hooks

product_ownership.name: Product Ownership

python_coding.name: Python Coding

release_manager.name: Release Manager
release_manager.description: Semantic version computation and schema diff checking for structured release management.

research_analysis.name: Research and Analysis

review_system.name: Review System
review_system.description: Code and architecture review subsystem covering pr-reviewer, architect-review, and change-scope-reviewer agents.

roadmap.description: Phase-based roadmap tracking outcomes, exit criteria, and ticket advancement state.

template_compiler.description: Compiles Jinja-style agent and skill templates into deployed artifacts during the build phase.

testing_quality.name: Testing and Quality
testing_quality.description: Test authoring and execution subsystem covering test-writer, test-runner, and ac-validator agents ensuring TDD discipline and AC coverage.

ticket_creation_pipeline.name: Ticket Creation Pipeline

ticket_lifecycle.name: Ticket Lifecycle
ticket_lifecycle.description: End-to-end ticket management from inbox to done including status transitions and sign-offs.

worktree_manager.name: Worktree Manager
worktree_manager.description: Git worktree lifecycle management for isolated epic and ticket branch environments.
